ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Information Systems, Management, Operations Management, Marketing and Supply Chain Management students on Monday, November 14, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to undergraduate Finance and Accountancy students as well as MSF, MSM, MSBA, MSTM and Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design undergraduate students on Monday, November 21, 2022 and to Innovation, Leadership & Engineering Entrepreneurship students on Monday, November 28, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 20, 2023 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
